text: Hello! Today we're making meatloaf. This is a recipe that I make quite often and
just like any kind of meatloaf it can be really individualized to your own
specific taste. You can put whatever you want in it but this is what I generally
put in mine. As a filler I put 1 1⁄2 cup of dry bread crumbs, 1 1⁄2 cup of
quick cooking oats, although you could use large flake oats as well. To this I
add 1 teaspoon of salt, about a teaspoon of pepper, about 1⁄2 cup of milk, 2
beaten eggs, and some garlic powder. I guess that's about a teaspoon and I put
some minced dried onion because Max doesn't like the fresh onions too much
in there so he doesn't seem to mind the dried onions, and a few shakes of Worcester
sauce. And you're gonna blend this together. Now really the only really good
way to blend meatloaf is with your hands. So that's what we're gonna do
next.
Okay there's two schools of thought as far as meatloaf goes. Some of them say
you should just hardly mix it at all. Mix it in just barely and leave the
meat alone. I like to mix the meat very very well. Mix the ingredients in very
well and work the meatloaf until it gets very smooth. It changes the consistency of
the meat. You'll get more of a compact loafy kind of texture to the meat after
it's cooked if you work it quite a bit. I like that. You may not. So you do it
what you want. Then take a large baking pan and you're gonna form it into a loaf
shape. Now what I do is on the top, the top I kind of flatten out a little bit
and I make it kind of into a very shallow canoe shape if you can imagine.
So that there's like an indentation on the top. Now this is just so that when
you pour the sauce over top that it holds it in. Now this is my sauce that I
make. I don't usually measure. I usually just kind of pour it into the bowl but I measured it just to see roughly what the quantities were.
That's about a cup of ketchup. I add about two heaping tablespoons of brown
sugar and about a tablespoon and a half or so of prepared yellow mustard and
about a tablespoon of Worcester sauce and stir this together and this is what's
gonna go over top of the meatloaf. And you'll see that the sauce, most of the
sauce will stay on the top of the meatloaf because you've created a little
spot for it. There it is just out of the oven. You want to bake it for about an
hour until a meat thermometer pushes it down.
And then you just let it rest for about 15 minutes and then you can slice it up.
